title: commands
description: Answer to a bare `stride --json` (or `--help`/`-h`/`help` under --json): what this binary accepts. Sourced from the parser's own command table, so the answer cannot drift from what actually parses. Flags are excluded — these are subcommands.

flags.description: flags this build accepts. --json, --human, --help and --version are GLOBAL; --all is accepted only by sync, where it forces a full re-list from scratch. The list does not encode that distinction, so a caller should not assume every flag works on every command.
